description: Use when an agent must see at once whether a wallet can cover something: the native balance plus the balance of every token you list, on one chain, in a single call, each already formatted with its symbol and decimals. One request instead of one per token. Do not use for a single token (/v1/evm/erc20-balance) or for what the tokens are worth (/v1/evm/token-price). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_portfolio
title: Wallet token portfolio
